stem:
A student wants to research data about the climate of McAllen, Texas.

Which data should the student research?

options.label: A
options.text: The wind speed at different times of the day

options.label: B
options.text: The amount of rainfall over several days

options.label: C
options.text: The average wind speed and amount of rainfall over one month

options.label: D
options.text: The average temperature and amount of rainfall over 30 years
